crossRefs.note: Afterward, David’s heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand…
I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good…

translations.web: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
translations.bsb: Therefore it is necessary to submit to authority, not only to avoid punishment, but also as a matter of conscience.
translations.kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
translations.asv: Wherefore ye must needs be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience' sake.
